subjects.name: Daniel Mercer
subjects.occupation: Senior Facilities Engineer, Northstar Facilities Ltd

transactions.proximity_to_incident: 5 days after MCR-2025-0291 (Kingsley Watch Co., 1–2 Apr)

subjects.analyst_note: Cash deposits follow each incident in the series with no legitimate income source identified for the amounts. Cumulative cash deposited: £19,000 over the series period. Transfers to Marcus Vale total £10,300 across four payments, all labelled 'consultancy'. No formal consultancy arrangement or invoice has been identified. Mercer's declared salary does not account for the deposit pattern.

subjects.name: Marcus Vale
subjects.analyst_note: Marcus Vale is Operations Manager at Northstar Facilities Ltd, the employer of Daniel Mercer. Vale has the authority to assign maintenance schedules, assign engineer credentials, and approve access to client premises. Receipt of payments totalling £10,300 from Mercer labelled 'consultancy' — with no consultancy arrangement on record — is consistent with payment for facilitation, specifically scheduling Mercer's access to Operation Nightfall premises. Investigation into Vale is at an early stage. He has not been interviewed.
